title: Slice 1: colour consultation with factors as source of truth
description: Implement docs/implementation-plan.md slice 1. Multiple-lighting portraits, quiz/reflections, unchanged-photo drapes, provisional 31-template match, personal palette and public explainer. Preserve underlying factors, evidence, uncertainty and preferences; classifications are derived summaries. Planning only until implementation requested.

title: Define factor-first session and validate atlas
description: Plan section 1. Versioned evidence/factor model; distinct observations/reports/hypotheses/preferences; unknown != neutral. Reviewed atlas import and provenance; 31/12/19 and wardrobe-role regression checks.

title: Build multiple-photo intake and short quiz
description: Multiple portraits with lighting notes and selected reference; preview/remove/replace; two written reflections and optional quiz. Editable and accessible. Use slice-0 authenticated saved profile checkpoints, superseding memory-only spec. See plan section 2.

title: Build identical-photo drapes and evidence updates
description: Plan section 3. Eight initial pairs; A/B/both/neither/unsure and comments; back/early finish/retry with another reference. Photo-specific evidence and conservative factors. Verify source/crop/transform identity.

title: Build provisional template result and separate taste filtering
description: Plan section 5. Derive candidates from factors; ambiguity is valid. Full template palette, separate exclusions, usable outfit colours where allowed, edit/redrape/reset, photo-free factor/evidence export. No forced class or preference-driven undertone.
notes: Record chosen template separately from inferred candidates/factors. Restore saved progress. Template selection is not observation evidence.

title: Add validated AI observations and explanations
description: Plan section 4. Current API docs; opt-in, server key, schema/evidence/ID validation, lighting confounders, bounded inference, timeout/abuse controls, honest failure and manual continuation. No face generation or raw photo logs.

title: Publish colour-system explainer
description: Plan section 6. /colour-system: three axes, continuous factors vs templates, 12 inside 31, neutral vs unknown, full wardrobe colours and taste vs harmony, provisional science/calibration limits. Public source credits; no private notes.

title: Verify and release complete colour journey
description: Plan section 7. Meaningful regressions plus desktop/mobile journey, multiple-photo handling, ambiguity, exclusions, export and explainer. Anonymous deployed access, README/credits, <=90-second demo and Codex contribution. Reserve submission buffer.

title: Slice 2: joint iterative body-line, style and essence consultation
description: See docs/implementation-plan.md. One on-user moodboard loop; region-specific factors and garment interactions, holistic essence descriptions plus tentative descriptors. No forced global yin/yang or separate essence verdict screen. Preserve observations, aspirations, preferences, hypotheses. User satisfaction alone ends exploration; save/resume unfinished rounds. Credits may pause but never force approval. Exact factor vocabulary still provisional.

title: Design factor vocabulary within joint style and essence consultation
description: Design subtask of stylist-iwx, not a separate user-flow stage. Test regional body factors and possible essence descriptors on examples; retain irreducible prose and uncertainty. No claim that aesthetic descriptors are validated orthogonal axes. See plan.

title: Add authenticated invite activation with independent attendee and judge codes
description: Supabase Auth; proposed verified-email default. Attendee shared invite max 100 accounts; judge invite independent configurable capacity. Hash secrets; atomic redemption, account uniqueness/idempotency, expiry/revocation, throttling. Test concurrent final slot and independent judge admission. No invite values in repo. See plan.

title: Enforce account credit allowances and protected judge budget
description: Authorize each paid endpoint server-side. Atomic pre-call cost reservation, bounded requests/concurrency, idempotent settlement and uncertain-failure reconciliation. Per-account caps and global cutoff; separate reserved judge budget so crowd cannot consume demo funds. Test concurrency/direct calls. Exact caps configurable and still to choose.

title: Save and resume private profiles and unfinished consultations
description: Account-owned profile/evidence/factors/current step and all moodboard rounds; RLS and private photo/board storage. Cross-device restore, explicit storage disclosure, deletion, two-user isolation tests. No fixed moodboard round cap; credit exhaustion pauses rather than approves. See plan.

title: Plan final editorial and grounded recommendations
description: After user approves coherent style/essence, generate glamorous edit and portable grammar. Small set of real product recommendations with checked retailer/price/size/link, satisfying harmony/taste/practicality/wardrobe separately. Honest style-only fallback if sourcing fails. See plan slice 3.
